request.text: You're back! What did you see? Will you teach me? To be a Wayfarer? In the stories every Wayfarer has a horse. Find me one? A brown one. She's mine? She's really mine? Bramble. Her name's Bramble. I'm not scared. I'm not. I'll watch for you tonight. From the very first smoke.
request.voice_description: Native English, British. Female, 18-20, petite, with a high, light, soft voice. Excellent quality. Persona: an orphan from a burnt town who dreams of becoming a wanderer. Emotion: eager, curious, hopeful, a little brave. Clear and natural, quick when excited, small and quiet when scared; not cartoonish, not squeaky.
